# Columns (tab-separated):
# dest
# tree is DERIVED from the two outcome columns, never authored (D-05):
#   symlink preserved AND repo untouched  -> stow
#   symlink DESTROYED OR  repo OVERWRITTEN -> restow
# Those are the only two values that ever appear. `capture` is not derivable
# from an installer-scoped map -- no installer primitive renames over the link
# the way switchwall.sh and matugen do -- so capture/ membership is hand-assigned
# prose in capture/README.md and is deliberately absent from this column.
# source cites the line of the primitive call site in sdata/subcmd-install/3.files-legacy.sh at the pin above.
# The MISC rows cite the [ -d ] / [ -f ] arm they were installed by; the inline
# rename cites its whole if/fi block.
# ORDERING (RESEARCH F-3) -- a guarantee, not an accident: rows are emitted
# through LC_ALL=C sort, keyed on the whole line and therefore on dest first.
# GNU find returns readdir order, which differs across filesystems and after
# directory-entry churn; without the sort the assert regenerate-and-diff would
# fire spuriously on a clean tree and the real pin-bump signal would be ignored.
# COVERAGE (D-04): every destination 3.files-legacy.sh writes, whichever XDG base it
# lands in -- so $XDG_DATA_HOME/konsole and $XDG_DATA_HOME/icons/... are in,
# alongside the $XDG_CONFIG_HOME rows. 2.setups.sh is out: its only link-touching
# line is a `sudo ln -s` for a systemd unit outside $HOME, which nothing here can
# capture. Font *package* installation and installer state are out; the fontconfig
# *destination* is in.
# NO SKIP_* COLUMN (D-06): Phase 16 retired the safe profile, so there is one
# install path and every SKIP_* is false on it. Paths keep their literal XDG
# variable and are expanded at read time, which keeps the map host-independent.
# install_file__auto_backup RECORDS THE FIRSTRUN OUTCOME (RESEARCH F-5).
# Firstrun renames the target away (`mv $t $t.old`, 3.files.sh:102) -- DESTROYED.
# On this host that branch is currently DISARMED, because
# ~/.config/illogical-impulse/installed_true exists: an install run today writes a
# .new sidecar and leaves hypridle.conf and hyprlock.conf intact. Deleting that
# marker, or passing upstream --firstrun, re-arms it. An empirical spot-check will
# therefore contradict these rows. The rows are right; the observation is the
# disarmed branch. Do NOT "correct" the map to match the host.
# KNOWN COVERAGE GAPS (RESEARCH F-13), neither a defect:
#   3.files-legacy.sh:42 -- the alternate fontconfig source under dots-extra/fontsets/,
#     reached only by upstream --fontset. Same destination, different source.
#   3.files-legacy.sh:66 -- the alternate hypridle.conf source under dots-extra/via-nix/,
#     reached only by --via-nix. Same destination, same primitive.
#   3.files-legacy.sh:72 -- the fedora-only execs.conf append, unreachable on Arch.
# The generator skips a call site whose SOURCE argument lives under dots-extra/;
# it is a flag-reached alternate, not a modelled destination.
# ACCEPTED RISK (D-32), stated so the gap is auditable rather than silent: the
# CAP-08 gate is a deny-list of exactly one flag, --exp-files. Upstream nix, core
# and skip-family flags still forward, and so does --fontset, which reaches
# 3.files-legacy.sh:42 -- a fontconfig source this map does not model. That is a
